scope: Read-only frontend/API request and saved record metadata preflight; no simulation/telemetry/CUA/worker cancellation/source edit

configuration.motor_source: Historical AeroTech G80_2007 preliminary numerical hypothesis; no current motor/physical adoption

preserved_design.rule: Record actual prepacket Design identity/selection/view and preserve it. Experiment configuration lives in separate experiment context; never switch Design to admit RP1 flight. Actual native Design identity remains for verifier to observe.

window_correction.reason: Tiny uses0.005s integration step and9000steps, so45s, not9s. API resource declaration, execution case and visible Preset label agree.
window_correction.first9s_view: A9s viewed/scrubbed segment precedes baseline apogee10.4/deployment10.7; this does not mean those events are missing from the45s record.

resources.storage: One record/resolved snapshot and at most max_steps rows of Parquet per member; retained locally without automatic deletion. Compressed bytes and JAX compilation memory vary by host.
resources.cancellation: cooperative before/after JAX rollout; an in-flight compiled rollout is not forcibly terminated

baseline.compatibility: Current model/source/profile/seed match verified using record metadata and present source bytes; no telemetry data was read. New run remains to be checked.

comparison.A: The single newly accepted run ID, unavailable until a future native POST is accepted
comparison.alignment: Absolute elapsed time; verify A/B offsets0
comparison.playback_profile: bounded, default normal playback; do not enable full-rate benchmark
comparison.claim_boundary: Only after actual new record matches these fields may this be described as a matched-source/profile/seed wind-speed sensitivity. A GUI comparison alone is not a controlled one-variable or independently validated physical result.
comparison.historical_full_runs: 116/132s sim-profile runs differ in duration/dt and model code; do not use as controlled Tiny baseline or borrow their geometry.

Set Vehicle and motor=Performance ·G80 reference; verify experiment IDmodular-performance-v1 and42-part matching source.
Set wind1.0m/s, direction toward0degrees clockwise from north, gust0, Preset tiny·45s/9000steps, seed20261107; ensure Bounded seed sweep unchecked.
Click Run on CPU once. Record exactly one accepted run ID and queued/running/terminal transitions. If acceptance uncertain, inspect saved attempts only; do not resubmit.
If complete within90s observation deadline, load actual new A from Saved runs and observe partial/full status plus exact settings/identities. Stop on failure/mismatch.
Use Saved runs search to locate baseline exp-d0baf4168f7f41e687a1b5f12e14cc3e, click its Compare button. Verify A=new ID/B=baseline ID; Absolute elapsed time, offsets0; normal bounded playback.

Inspect displayed events/validity and scrub to a recorded in-range guide-exit/burnout or apogee event; use Fit both trajectories. Optional Play then Pause for at most5s actual interaction, not a full-flight/performance qualification.

Reset plot range, remain paused and request Download A range CSV plus Download A metadata JSON once. Observe actual download and expected<newRunID>-playback.csv/.json; metadata retains A/B IDs, source/settings/profile/range/alignment. B export is optional only if packet time remains.
Return to Design and verify original identity/view state preserved; no changes to RP1, archived geometry or physical gates.

event_expectations.new_run: Do not predict new times as facts. Preserve actual missing events and partial status; lack of landing within45s is expected from this baseline, not a parser/flight-completion pass.

budgets_and_stops.hard_timeout_limitation: Existing API has no hard per-run computation deadline. Cancellation only checks before/after compiled rollout. At90s cease packet actions and report observed pending state; no claim of worker termination. If a guaranteed≤90s worker limit is mandatory, this packet is not admitted without a separately authorized bounded runner.
stop_conditions: Uncertain acceptance or more than one accepted ID
Missing compatible baseline in current saved-run list
Export coverage rejection or deadline; preserve evidence, no retake

evidence_boundaries.native_interaction: Pending sole designated verifier and primary admission
